title: Common words, verbs and plurals
intro: Some frequent words need extra practice. Read each word in a sentence and notice any unusual spelling. Word endings can show more than one thing or a change in an action.
support: عامې کلمې په جمله کې ولولئ او ځانګړې لیکنه یې وګورئ. پایونه د ډېرو شیانو یا د کار بدلون ښودلی شي.
text: A duck jumps. Two ducks jump. Yesterday one duck jumped.
model: Box takes es in boxes. Pen takes s in pens. The base jump stays the same in jumps, jumped and jumping. Tap doubles p before ed in tapped. In said, notice the unusual ai spelling.
activity: Make a sign for a shop with one item and two items. Use cup, box or dish.
adult: Say “one cup, two …” and pause for the learner to supply the plural. Repeat with box. Listen for the different endings.
adultPs: cup او box ووایئ. له ماشومه وغواړئ چې د هرې کلمې جمع ووایي.

rounds.hint: Box takes es for more than one.
rounds.instruction: انګلیسي پوښتنه ولولئ او برخې په ترتیب وټاکئ.

rounds.hint: Look for the ending that fits an action happening now.

tasks: Read the and was in sentences that an adult writes. Copy both once.
Write one pen and then two pens. Circle the added letter.
Draw one box and three boxes. Label both drawings.
Read jumps, jumped and jumping. Underline their endings.
Cover one and said. Write each from memory and check it.
Ask someone to help spell an unfamiliar classroom word. Write it in your log.
Read “A duck jumps. Two ducks jump.” Underline the plural and use it in a new sentence.
Label a drawing of one dish and one of three dishes. Underline the plural ending.
Write two captions about tapping a drum, one about yesterday and one about now.
Write a new sentence containing said. Check it against the word in your spelling log.
